hero.title: Know what is on the shelf before anyone asks.
hero.lede: A scan, a sale and a reorder should all describe the same item. Sikick keeps the catalog, the till and the purchase orders on one stock count, so the number you see is the number you have.
cta.final.title: See your stock clearly.
cta.final.lede: Start a 14-day trial of Core or AI, or design your setup in the configurator — no payment method required.
footer.tagline: Inventory, purchasing, POS and business insights — connected in one clear system for retail, wholesale, distribution and manufacturing.
pricing.title: Simple plans, honest prices.
pricing.lede: Prices below are base subscription prices. Applicable GST is calculated at checkout and itemized on your invoice.
pricing.gstNote: Base price excludes applicable GST; tax is calculated and itemized at checkout.
